==Airlines and destinations==
The Qantas Group is the dominant operator at Launceston airport, with [[Jetstar]] operating up to six daily flights to/from [[Melbourne Airport|Melbourne]], up to two daily flights to/from [[Sydney Airport|Sydney]] and up to one daily flight to/from [[Brisbane Airport|Brisbane]] throughout the year. [[QantasLink]] operates up to four flights daily to/from Melbourne, up to two daily flights to/from Sydney and seasonal services to/from Brisbane.{{cn|date=May 2026}}

[[Virgin Australia]] operates up to four daily flights to/from Melbourne, one daily flight to/from Sydney, between four and seven flights per week to/from [[Brisbane Airport|Brisbane]] as well as a number of seasonal flights to/from [[Adelaide Airport|Adelaide]] and [[Perth Airport|Perth]].

[[Sharp Airlines]] offer daily direct flights to [[Flinders Island Airport|Flinders Island]] and [[King Island]].

[[Par Avion (airline)|Par Avion]] provide a twice weekly service to Cape Barren Island under the Remote Air Services Subsidy (RASS) scheme. in addition to light aircraft charter.
